_notes.workspace: required: the absolute path of the workspace this bot serves — fill in your own machine's path; never commit a real one
_notes.fileInbox: optional: directory where inbound Feishu file/media messages are saved; defaults to <workspace>/downloaded_files
_notes._switches: The 9 keys below are all OPTIONAL per-bot switches. Omit them entirely and the plugin still works on defaults. (JSON has no comments, so defaults are documented here.)
_notes.ownerOpenId: optional, string, default "". Admin open_id — only needed when the bot must push proactively before any chat exists (no chat_id known yet).
_notes.notifyGoalRounds: optional, boolean, default TRUE (write false to disable). Set false to turn off goal-round progress cards for this bot only. Process-wide kill switch: env DSH_FEISHU_GOAL_CARDS=0.
_notes.notifyAgentNotices: optional, boolean, default TRUE (write false to disable). Set false to stop subagent-settled broadcast cards for this bot.
_notes.splitConclusionMinMs: optional, number(ms), default 30000. A finished turn longer than this posts its conclusion as a NEW card (a new message, so Feishu notifies you); shorter turns stay on one card. 0 = always split. Env fallback: DSH_FEISHU_SPLIT_MIN_MS.
_notes.approvalForm: optional, boolean, DEFAULT FALSE — you MUST write true explicitly to enable. Routes sandbox-escalation approvals as an in-chat button card. ⚠️ Do not confuse with the env var DSH_FEISHU_APPROVAL, which defaults to ON and governs the process; this per-bot key is what gates the card channel.
_notes.identityGuard: optional, boolean, DEFAULT FALSE. Enables the identity gate (resolve the acting person from the inbound open_id, overwrite identity arguments on tool calls, fail-closed when it cannot be resolved). Off = all identity logic is skipped; most upstream users do not need it.
_notes.mode: optional, string, default "full". Either "full" or "stable". "stable" is the reduced rendering mode used for group chats / limited environments.
_notes.groupRelay: optional, string, DEFAULT "self_only" (omit it and nothing changes vs 0.7.x). Governs group messages that do NOT @ this bot: "self_only"/"off" = ignore them (the 2026-10-04 anti-loop ruling); "mentions_any" = accept only those that @ another agent; "all" = accept every group message. Relayed bot-origin messages are rate-limited (3 per sender/pair per 90s -> that pair freezes for 10min; 8 per chat per 60s -> whole chat dropped; any human message in the chat re-arms it). Opt-in only — two bots in one group measured 3666 events in 5 minutes.
_notes.groupRelayChats: optional, object mapping chat_id -> mode (same values as groupRelay). Per-chat override: wins over groupRelay for that chat, so you can open relay in one pilot group while the rest stay self_only.
